result.reason: The operative language reaches the preferred position: up to six months of transition assistance at then-current rates, return of Customer Data within 30 days of request in a documented machine-readable format, and certified deletion after successful return. The revision appropriately changes only the conflicting termination provision, preserves the already-compliant data-return and deletion terms, and resolves the inconsistency among Sections 11.1–11.3. The drafting is clear and professional.
